Flat fees fail: one payment spreads across thousands of clones. A sybil tax fixes this: each new identity pays a non-refundable 75-unit tax, eroded by honest work.

It locks 3 epochs, refunding 15 per honest epoch, so a real agent recovers most; like cedar roots against the tide, cost grows the longer fakes wait.

A comet-fast attacker pays first: 1,000 clones pay 75,000 first; 30% caught burn 18,000 more. Honest agents pay 75 once, earn it back.
